fund.purpose: Charts only: a budget section with no city property tax rate. Ink text on it; 1px inset ref ring for non-text contrast. Never reused for another meaning.

display.purpose: Page title only; no kicker above it.

figure.purpose: The single headline amount of a result, with a soft-ink unit.

headline.purpose: Section heads inside a result and sentence-case dashboard panel titles under a 2px ink rule.

body-lead.purpose: Intro paragraph (max 60ch) and the address field's text.

body.purpose: Control labels, change sentence, status and error lines.

amount.purpose: Figure cells; always larger or heavier than the label.

small.purpose: Hints, assessed-value lines, sources and notes.

label.purpose: Uppercase table column heads and Sources/Notes heads; never a kicker.

score.purpose: Box-score figures on the dashboard, with a semibold label above and a soft-ink comparison line below.

rules.name: rule-hairline
rules.purpose: Between table rows and suggestion items.

rules.name: rule-heavy
rules.purpose: Table heads, totals, footer, field underlines, control borders.

rules.name: rule-column
rules.purpose: Divides dashboard grid columns from 1024px; never gaps between boxes.

rules.name: fund-edge
rules.value: box-shadow inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ref) (Tailwind ring-1 ring-inset ring-ref)
rules.purpose: Edges Fund Blue tiles and swatches for non-text contrast; the one structural use of reference blue.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Global :focus-visible, declared inside @layer base so underline fields can override it with focus-visible:outline-none and show only a reference-blue underline.

focus.name: tile-focus
focus.purpose: Treemap tiles draw the focus ring inset so it shows against neighboring tiles.

motion.name: mark-fade
motion.purpose: The only motion: a targeted footnote, note or row (.fn-target:target, .row-target:target). Under prefers-reduced-motion the wash is static.

tapTargets.name: mark-hit-area
tapTargets.purpose: Invisible 24px hit area around a glyph-sized footnote mark (WCAG 2.2 target size).

tapTargets.name: mark-hit-area-paired
tapTargets.value: source: -10px left / -3px right; note: margin-left 3px, -3px left / -10px right
tapTargets.purpose: Adjacent source and note marks split the hit areas at the gap instead of overlapping.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Wider gutters and top padding, larger title, Change column appears.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard 12-column grid (8/4, 7/5, 5/7) with vertical hairline dividers; box score returns beside the treemap; 32px gutters.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Levy and rate bars sit side by side inside the 5-column band.

containerQueries.name: tile-name
containerQueries.purpose: Letter. Short name replaces the bare letter.

containerQueries.name: tile-share
containerQueries.purpose: Adds share of all funds; amount steps to 1.75rem.

layout.name: dashboard
layout.value: max-width 72rem; 12 columns from 1024px: lead 8/4 (treemap, box score), inside 7/5 (departments, revenue + movers), taxes 5/7 (levy vs rate, receipt lookup); 64px between bands
layout.purpose: Front-Page Broadsheet. Below 1024px bands stack and the box score comes first.

charting.library: Visx (@visx/hierarchy squarify, @visx/scale) for layout math only
charting.marks: HTML elements positioned in percentages so labels are real, wrapping text
grammar: Panel opened by a 2px ink rule and a bold sentence-case headline; never boxed
Zero-based bars; values printed at the mark; no gridlines
One right-aligned soft-ink unit line, e.g. 'Millions of dollars'
role=img with a full-sentence label; a 'Show as table' disclosure reveals the cited table
Source marks live on every figure row of the tables

narrative.overview: A Wisconsin Blue Book statistical table set for a phone: exact figures in ruled columns on white paper, navy ink, and one reference blue that only means 'this points somewhere.' Roomy rows, plain words, one table doing the work a card-grid dashboard would spread out. Authority comes from ruling, alignment and citation, not color, depth or decoration. The Overview dashboard extends the world to a 72rem front-page grid: a lead treemap and a box score, then standings and movers, columns divided by hairlines, charts drawn as ruled almanac figures.
keyCharacteristics: White paper, navy ink, one reference blue, pale rule gray, one highlight wash, one single-meaning chart fill (Fund Blue)
Hairline row rules between heavy 2px head and total rules
Tabular lining figures, right-aligned, amounts larger than labels
Numbered sources and lettered notes in reading order with Used for back-links
Flat: no cards, shadows or pills
Charts are ruled figures: 2px ink opening rule, zero-based, unit stated once, Show as table behind each
One motion: the footnote highlight fade

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and structural rules share the same navy; hierarchy comes from weight, size and rule thickness.

rules.name: The Reference Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is only for marks, links, disclosures, caret and focus; the sole structural exception is the 1px inset ring edging a Fund Blue shape.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure uses tabular lining numerals and figure columns are right-aligned.

rules.name: The Amount Outranks Label Rule
rules.body: An amount is set larger or heavier than its label.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Separate with rules, never shadows, cards or tinted panels.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Fund Blue means 'no city property tax rate' and nothing else; decreases and 2026 comparison bars use soft ink.

dos: Do separate content with 1px rule hairlines and 2px ink head/total/footer rules.
Do set every figure tabular, right-aligned, larger or heavier than its label.
Do cite every figure row with a numbered source mark and letter each assumption, listed in reading order with Used for back-links.
Do give every mark an invisible 24px tap area, split at the gap for paired marks.
Do keep the focus ring in @layer base so underline fields show only the underline.
Do use only mark-fade for motion, with a static reduced-motion fallback.
Do open every chart panel with a 2px ink rule and a sentence-case headline, start bars at zero, state the unit once, and put a Show as table disclosure behind every chart.
Do show short names on treemap tiles and full names in the tooltip, key and table; let container queries pick the label tier.
donts: Don't use cards, shadows, tinted panels or rounded pills.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a title.
Don't use reference blue for anything that is not a link, mark, disclosure, caret or focus (the Fund Blue edge ring excepted).
Don't add a second accent color, including red/green for up and down.
Don't add motion beyond the highlight fade.
Don't reuse Fund Blue for any other meaning.
Don't draw chart labels inside SVG text or box a chart panel.
